        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  if (\n    request.nextUrl.pathname !== \"/\" &amp;&amp;\n    !user &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/login\") &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/auth\")\n  ) {\n    // no user, potentially respond by redirecting the user to the login page\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n}",

        "contents": "student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer)\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:",

M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);",

            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "create table public.users (",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "  email text not null,",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "  picture text,",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 104
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { InfoIcon } from \"lucide-react\";\nimport { FetchDataSteps } from \"@/components/tutorial/fetch-data-steps\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\n\nasync function UserDetails() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  if (error || !data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return JSON.stringify(data.claims, null, 2);\n}\n\nexport default function ProtectedPage() {\n  return\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "---\nname: Work Email Auth System\noverview: Build a robust authentication system using Supabase with Google OAuth, work email verification (@studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz)\ntodos:\n  - id: db-schema\n    content: Create Supabase migration for users and profiles tables with RLS\n    status: pending\n  - id: profile-verification\n    content: Implement database-based profile verification (no JWT claims)\n    status: pending\n  - id: supabase-config\n    content: Update supabase/config.toml (manual_linking, Google OAuth, security settings)\n    status: pending\n  - id: auth-constants\n    content: Create lib/constants/auth.ts with domain validation and role constants\n    status: pending\n  - id: server-actions\n    content: Create lib/actions/auth.ts with profile linking, verification, and access revocation\n    status: pending\n  - id: middleware-update\n    content: Update proxy.ts to query profiles table for verified user and access status\n    status: pending\n  - id: google-login\n    content: Create Google login button and rewrite login page\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-email-flow\n    content: Create work email verification page with OTP and identity linking\n    status: pending\n  - id: pending-approval-page\n    content: Create pending approval page for users without profiles\n    status: pending\n  - id: access-revoked-page\n    content: Create access revoked page for users with revoked access\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# Work Email Authentication System\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1

        "contents": "### Supabase (Data Layer)\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable.         "contents": "  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data with RLS for row-level access control\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers for business rules\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │\n│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────────┐  │\n│  │ Middleware  │  │   Server    │  │      Components         │  │\n│  │ - Auth check│  │   Actions   │  │  - Login form           │  │",

            "text": "  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "// Link profile to current user",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "await supabase",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "  .from('profiles')",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "  .update({ ",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "    user_id: user.id,",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "  })",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "  .eq('work_email', workEmail);",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 4: Middleware Validation",
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "Query database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "// Middleware check",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "const { data: profile } = await supabase",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "text": "  .from('profiles')",
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "  .select('id, role, removed_access')",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "  .eq('user_id', user.id)",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "  .single();",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "if (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "if (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "// User has active access, continue...",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "## Estimated Complexity",
            "lineNumber": 340
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 343
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|------------|---------------|",
            "lineNumber": 344
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 345
          },
          {
            "text": "| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 346
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 347
          },
          {
            "text": "| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |",
            "lineNumber": 348
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 349
          },
          {
            "text": "| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |",
            "lineNumber": 350
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 351
          },
          {
            "text": "| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 352
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 353
          },
          {
            "text": "| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 354
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 355
          },
          {
            "text": "| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |",
            "lineNumber": 356
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 357
          },
          {
            "text": "| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 358
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 359
          },
          {
            "text": "| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 360
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 361
          },
          {
            "text": "| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 362
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 363
          },
          {
            "text": "| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |",
            "lineNumber": 364
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 365
          },
          {
            "text": "**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)",
            "lineNumber": 366
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 367
          },
          {
            "text": "## Separation of Concerns",
            "lineNumber": 368
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 369
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)",
            "lineNumber": 370
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 371
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails",
            "lineNumber": 372
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database**: Store profiles and users data with RLS for row-level access control",
            "lineNumber": 373
          },
          {
            "text": "- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers for business rules",
            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "text": "### Next.js (All Business Logic)",
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules",
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐",
            "lineNumber": 383
          },
          {
            "text": "│                         Next.js                                  │",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────────┐  │",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "text": "│  │ Middleware  │  │   Server    │  │      Components         │  │",
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "│  │ - Auth check│  │   Actions   │  │  - Login form           │  │",
            "lineNumber": 387
          }
        ]

        "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]\nenabled = true\nport = 54327\n# Configure one of the supported backends: &#96;postgres&#96;, &#96;bigquery&#96;.\nbackend = \"postgres\"\n\n# Experimental features may be deprecated any time\n[experimental]\n# Configures Postgres storage engine to use OrioleDB (S3)",

        "contents": "### ORM Best Practices\n\n- Use type-safe ORMs (Drizzle, Prisma, etc.)\n- Define schemas with proper relationships and constraints\n- Infer types from schema definitions\n- Write repository-style helpers to isolate queries\n- Implement proper migrations\n\n### Data Access Patterns\n\n- Keep database queries in dedicated modules\n- Avoid N+1 queries; use joins and CTEs\n- Implement pagination for list endpoints\n- Use select projections to limit payload size\n\n## Authentication &amp; Authorization\n\n- Implement server-side auth checks\n- Never trust client-side auth flags\n- Use middleware for route protection\n- Store user data securely with proper encryption\n\n## Testing Strategy\n\n### Unit Testing (Vitest)\n\n- **Never mock internal code** - only mock external dependencies\n- Use MSW for API mocking when needed\n- Test utilities, repositories, and business logic\n- Mock external services (APIs, databases, file systems)\n\n### Component Testing (React Testing Library)\n\n- Test interactive components with proper accessibility\n- Ensure loading and error states are covered\n- Test user interactions and state changes\n- Use data-testid sparingly; prefer semantic queries\n\n### Integration Testing\n\n- Test API endpoints with real database connections\n- Use test databases with proper cleanup\n- Test authentication flows end-to-end\n- Mock external services consistently\n\n### Test Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Example test structure\ndescribe(\"Feature\", () =&gt; {\n  describe(\"when condition\", () =&gt; {\n    it(\"should expected behavior\", async () =&gt; {\n      // Arrange\n      // Act\n      // Assert\n    });\n  });\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Error Handling &amp; Observability\n\n- Implement early returns on invalid input (fail fast)\n- Use typed error codes and messages\n- Log server-side with contextual metadata\n- Never expose stack traces to clients\n- Provide user-friendly error messages\n\n## Security Best Practices\n\n- Validate all inputs at boundaries\n- Use environment variables for sensitive data (server-only)\n- Implement proper CORS policies\n- Sanitize user inputs\n- Use HTTPS in production\n- Implement rate limiting where appropriate",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nauth_token = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)\"\n\n# Multi-factor-authentication is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n[auth.mfa]\n# Control how many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.\nmax_enrolled_factors = 10\n\n# Control MFA via App Authenticator (TOTP)\n[auth.mfa.totp]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\n\n# Configure MFA via Phone Messaging\n[auth.mfa.phone]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\notp_length = 6\ntemplate = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Configure MFA via WebAuthn\n# [auth.mfa.web_authn]\n# enroll_enabled = true\n# verify_enabled = true\n\n# Use an external OAuth provider. The full list of providers are: &#96;apple&#96;, &#96;azure&#96;, &#96;bitbucket&#96;,\n# &#96;discord&#96;, &#96;facebook&#96;, &#96;github&#96;, &#96;gitlab&#96;, &#96;google&#96;, &#96;keycloak&#96;, &#96;linkedin_oidc&#96;, &#96;notion&#96;, &#96;twitch&#96;,\n# &#96;twitter&#96;, &#96;x&#96;, &#96;slack&#96;, &#96;spotify&#96;, &#96;workos&#96;, &#96;zoom&#96;.\n[auth.external.apple]\nenabled = false\nclient_id = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your OAuth provider secret to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nsecret = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_APPLE_SECRET)\"\n# Overrides the default auth redirectUrl.\nredirect_uri = \"\"\n# Overrides the default auth provider URL.         "range": {

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install &amp;&amp; pnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",
